_readme: Breathing presets. 'seconds' is [inhale, hold, exhale, hold] — a 0 means that phase is skipped, which is how 4-7-8 (no second hold) and coherent breathing (no holds at all) reuse the same four-number shape instead of needing a special case. The app's steppers can override any of these; only the last-used seconds are remembered on the device, not which preset they came from.
